# RotateOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for a native, atomic rotation wrapper.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type RotateOptions = ElementOptions & Partial<Pick<Rotate, 'child' | 'angle' | 'mode'>> & {
    /** Positive width before rotation; points or a unit token. */
    contentWidth?: LengthInput;
}
```

## Properties

- [`angle`](#angle): Finite clockwise degrees, default zero.
- [`breakAllowed`](#breakallowed): Whether this element can be split across page boundaries.
- [`captureName`](#capturename): Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot.
- [`child`](#child): The native subtree to rotate.
- [`contentDirection`](#contentdirection): Inline progression and paragraph base direction; omitted inherits.
- [`contentWidth`](#contentwidth): Positive width before rotation; points or a unit token.
- [`keepWithNext`](#keepwithnext): Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.
- [`margin`](#margin): Margin around this element.
- [`mode`](#mode): Free keeps the flow box; constrained accepts multiples of 90 degrees.

### `angle`

```typescript
angle?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Finite clockwise degrees, default zero.

### `breakAllowed`

```typescript
breakAllowed?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether this element can be split across page boundaries. When false, the element is treated as atomic and will be moved to a new page rather than split. If it doesn't fit on a fresh page either, it renders anyway. Default is true.

### `captureName`

```typescript
captureName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot. Unset by default; a future capture API can populate it.

### `child`

```typescript
child?: IElement | undefined
```

*optional*

The native subtree to rotate.

### `contentDirection`

```typescript
contentDirection?: ContentDirectionInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Inline progression and paragraph base direction; omitted inherits.

### `contentWidth`

```typescript
contentWidth?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Positive width before rotation; points or a unit token.

### `keepWithNext`

```typescript
keepWithNext?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.

### `margin`

```typescript
margin?: ThicknessInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Margin around this element. Accepts `12`, `[h, v]`, `[l, t, r, b]` or `{ bottom: 12 }`; omitted sides are zero.

### `mode`

```typescript
mode?: RotationMode | undefined
```

*optional*

Free keeps the flow box; constrained accepts multiples of 90 degrees.
